description: This file implements a rate limiting mechanism for the Mattermost server, defining a RateLimiter class with methods for generating keys, applying rate limits, and setting HTTP headers related to rate limiting.

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: A struct that manages rate limiting using throttled.GCRARateLimiter, with options for user and IP based limits, headers, and trusted proxy headers.

methods.name: NewRateLimiter
methods.description: Constructor for RateLimiter, initializes rate limiter with settings and trusted proxy headers.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a rate limiting key based on authentication token, IP address, and optional header.

methods.name: RateLimitWriter
methods.description: Applies rate limiting to a request, sets headers, and responds with error if limit exceeded.

methods.name: UserIdRateLimit
methods.description: Applies rate limiting based on user ID if authentication is used.

methods.name: RateLimitHandler
methods.description: Wraps an HTTP handler with rate limiting logic.
